g.text: Half of urban Balochistan's earners make under Rs 250,000 a year; the top tenth make over Rs 540,000
Source: PSLM 2019-20, person file merged with household file. Sample: Balochistan urban earners aged 15-64 with earn_annual > 0 (n = 486).
Weighted by hhweight. Earners outside Rs 10,000-10,000,000 excluded: 0.
